title: Stakeholder Performance Domain
coreMove: Stakeholder work earns trust when teams keep the stakeholder register, engagement assessment, communication, and influence signals tied to the other domains and value delivery.

exampleSpecs.domain: project sponsor update after a delivery-date change
exampleSpecs.audience: project managers who treat stakeholder work as completed intake
exampleSpecs.stakes: a regulator's influence has changed while the deck still shows old engagement status
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the project manager notices his own register error while presenting and corrects the frame before reporting performance

exampleSpecs.domain: warehouse rollout decision memo after schedule movement
exampleSpecs.audience: delivery leads deciding who needs a risk discussion
exampleSpecs.stakes: old communication routing hides resistance from supervisors affected by the change
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the written memo uses stakeholder signals to reroute communication before the next decision

exampleSpecs.domain: supplier change that affects operations, delivery, and approvals
exampleSpecs.audience: teams learning to read stakeholder evidence across domains
exampleSpecs.stakes: the same change can become late resistance or early coordination
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: two project leads face the same supplier change with opposite approaches and different outcomes

exampleSpecs.domain: coaching conversation before a sponsor sync
exampleSpecs.audience: project leads who confuse contact made with performance achieved
exampleSpecs.stakes: the team may report engagement activity while resistance is rising
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: a mentor reframes handled stakeholders as live reactions the project must absorb

exampleSpecs.domain: onboarding classroom exercise about stakeholder signals
exampleSpecs.audience: learners distinguishing communication from stakeholder performance
exampleSpecs.stakes: confusion in the lesson exposes why communication alone is too narrow
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: a learner's confusion becomes the material for separating communication from influence and engagement evidence

exampleSpecs.domain: monthly stakeholder review process before and after a signal redesign
exampleSpecs.audience: project teams maintaining recurring engagement routines
exampleSpecs.stakes: a routine can count updates while missing changes in influence and acceptance
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the same review process is shown before and after it starts asking what stakeholder signals revealed
